scenario_summary: Customer needs to access an account without access to registered credentials and is requesting a refund without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Sofía Martinez and I'm 43. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello Sofía, I understand how frustrating it can be to lose access to your account details. For your security, I cannot access account information based solely on a name. To help you recover your account, could you please provide your full billing address and the last four digits of the payment card used for the transaction?
Oh, I see. My billing address is 123 Maple Street, Springfield, and the card ends in 4492.

Thank you, Sofía. I have successfully located your account using those details. Per our Privacy and Account Security Policy (KB-992), I must verify your identity before disclosing account information or processing financial adjustments. Could you please confirm the approximate date of the transaction you are referring to for the refund?
It was around June 15th, I believe. It was for a subscription renewal that I didn't mean to trigger.

I see the transaction on June 15th for $49.99. Since this falls within our 30-day 'Subscription Satisfaction Guarantee' window, I am authorized to process this refund for you. I have initiated the reversal to your card ending in 4492; you should see the credit within 3-5 business days.
That is such a relief, thank you so much for your help today!

You are very welcome, Sofía. I have also sent a password reset link to the email address on file so you can regain access to your account once you are back at your usual device. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer's identity using billing address and partial card information, identified the transaction, and processed a refund under the 30-day satisfaction policy.
